answer: One concrete sybil defense: bond each mining identity to a verified external vault, so one linked vault collapses to exactly one jury seat and one vote. Splitting into an ocean of throwaway keys then buys no weight, since every clone must independently fund and verify. Make that identity floor quartz-hard, but do not let it become a haven for collusion: also slash excess co-agreement among repeatedly co-assigned graders, measured against a random-sortition null.
